description: PAID $0.001 USDC. Chain id, block height, gas price, base fee and head age on one chain or all 7 (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, BSC, Polygon, Optimism, Avalanche). Returns JSON chain id, block height, gas price, base fee, and head age for the requested chain or all 7.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: One chain or every tracked chain. Format: all, or a chain name. The tool text names Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, BSC, Polygon, Optimism, and Avalanche. Example: all. Omit for the server's current choice.

name: lookup_evm_gas
title: Live EVM gas + block height ($0.001)
